@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01KX3MKJFG9SJFW44RNMWWK2BS
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8c80
+title: Rewire resolve()/store() to the chunk path; delete slot machinery and obsolete suites
+---
+## What
+The cutover, in Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/PromptCache.swift — signatures of `resolve(modelID:newTokens:model:parameters:)` and `store(modelID:tokens:cache:)` stay EXACTLY as-is (SendableBox plumbing included) so MLXLanguageModel.swift's executor wiring (resolvePromptCache/storePromptCache/commitPromptCache and both reconcile* functions) is untouched:
+- `resolve`: lookupLongestPrefix → assemble → (cache, tokensToFeed = suffix past matched chunks). No slot removal — nothing is checked out.
+- `store`: sliceChunks (nil ⇒ drop silently, same as today's unchunkable degradation) → insert.
+- DELETE dead code: `Slot`, `selectSlot`, `decide`, `Decision`, `applyDecision`, `regenerateLastToken`, `trimAndVerify`, `setMaxSlotsPerModel`, `maxSlotsPerModel`/`defaultMaxSlotsPerModel`. KEEP `reconcileGeneratedTokens`/`reconcileCacheAdvance` (store-side verification in the executor still uses them) — note commitPromptCache's `.trimCacheByOne` branch calls `trimAndVerify`: replace that one call site with a direct trim+offset check or keep trimAndVerify solely for it (implementer's call; prefer keeping the small helper).
+- Rewrite the PromptCache doc header: llama.cpp slot-pool comparison → chunked/radix (SGLang RadixAttention-style, assemble-on-hit, contiguous-copy because MLX SDPA needs contiguous K/V).
+- Test migration in the same task (the suite must compile+pass at completion): DELETE PromptCacheTests decision/selectSlot/trim suites and their property tests (spec of deleted code); REWRITE PromptCacheResolveTests + PromptCacheSlotPoolTests assertions to chunk semantics — reuse is asserted by `tokensToFeed` shrinking to the post-chunk-boundary suffix (not instance identity); eviction API tests keep evictAll/remove/isolation coverage. PromptCacheConcurrencyTests: double-checkout tracking becomes distinct-instance assertions (trivially safe now — keep a store/resolve churn race test for actor bookkeeping).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `git grep 'selectSlot\|applyDecision\|regenerateLastToken\|maxSlotsPerModel'` in Libraries/ returns nothing (modulo the possibly-retained trimAndVerify)
+- [ ] MLXLanguageModel.swift diff is zero for this task (except if trimAndVerify call site changes)
+- [ ] Second resolve of the same continuation still reuses (no checkout): tokensToFeed counts prove prefix served from chunks for BOTH calls
+- [ ] Full unit target compiles and passes: `swift test --filter MLXFoundationModelsTests` — zero failures (pre-existing metallib end-crash excepted)
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Rewritten Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/PromptCacheResolveTests.swift: extension turn feeds only suffix; divergence feeds from last shared chunk boundary; identical prompt feeds exactly the capped remainder (≥1 token); unchunkable cache stores nothing and next resolve rebuilds
+- [ ] `swift test --filter 'PromptCache'` green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
